title: Francisco
lyrics_plain: ALL rights reserved. Not for broadcast or transmission of any kind. DO NOT DUPLICATE. NOT FOR RENTAL. The loveliness of Paris seems somehow sadly gay. The glory that was Rome is over 'nother day. I've been terribly alone and forgotten in Manhattan. I'm going home to my city by the bay. I left my heart in San Francisco. High on a hill, it calls to me. To be where little cable cars climb halfway to the stars! The morning fog may chill the air, I don't care! My love waits there in San Francisco, above the blue and windy sea. When I come home to you, San Francisco, your golden sun will shine for me!
